cpay_494ca4_IdempotencyKey.name: X-CPay-Idempotency-Key
cpay_494ca4_IdempotencyKey.description: Merchant-scoped request identity. Identical requests replay their stored result; different bodies conflict. Failed request cleanup replays REQUEST_FAILED without releasing the key. Abandoned claims recover after 15 minutes. Check the payment reference before using a new key; REQUEST_FAILED does not prove provider failure.

cpay_494ca4_PaymentResult.description: Payment lifecycle result. REQUEST_FAILED represents an incomplete API request, not a terminal provider outcome; query the reference before retrying.
